## Method

# Guide

Load `project-knowledge:project-knowledge` and execute its canonical method for
`$ARGUMENTS`. Reuse a caller's owned run and authorizations; otherwise initialize
one through `project-protocol:project-protocol`. Use preparation.md and guide-method.md from the loaded skill. Full means the requested scope, not a mandatory numbered package. Choose only the needed writers.

Preserve native reports, source/intent distinctions, snapshot identity and
